## Friedrich Nietzsche on growth

Friedrich Nietzsche (1844–1900) approaches growth within genealogy and vitalism. Genealogical critique traces “good” and “evil” to historical power struggles rather than eternal reason. Perspectivism denies a view from nowhere without collapsing into lazy relativism. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets growth most directly—useful for searches such as “friedrich nietzsche quotes on growth.”
